Srisailam Reservoir Receives Heavy Inflows, Crosses 100 TMC Mark

The Srisailam Reservoir has received significant inflows, crossing the 100 Thousand Million Cubic (TMC) feet mark. This substantial water accumulation is generating optimism for the upcoming Kharif irrigation season. The heavy inflows are continuing to be observed at the reservoir.
